main_text.p: » pro bonâ voluntate. Ut ergo liberrimus » est iste agendi modus, quoad Deum: (Spi- » ritus enim, ubi vult, spirat. Joh.3.v.8. Et, » miseretur Deus, cujus vult. Rom.9.v.18.) ita est certissimus; nec à nostrâ voluntate » dependet, aut impediri potest. Voluntatis enim ejus quis resistat? v.19. Consilium Jehovae stabit. Prov.19 v.21. Esa.46.v.10. Quis id » irritum faciet? Esa.14.v.27. Solidum Dei » fundamentum stat, habens sigillum hoc: Novit Dominus, qui sunt sui. 2 Tim.2.v.19. Ne- » mo rapiet oves meas ex manibus meis. Joh.10. » v.28. Qui cœpit in vobis opus bonum, idem per- » ficiet, usque ad adventum Christi. Phil.i.v. » 6.Deus est, qui efficit in vobis, ut velitis & per- » ficiatis. Phil.2.v.13.

Hæc & similia tamen Remonstrantibus tanta non sunt; ut non dubitent de §. De Perseve-rantia. perseverantione omnium verè credentium: quamvis eam negent, Grotii sententiâ, Chrysostomus, Augustinus, Prosper.

page.notes: Quotation-continuation marks at the start of lines in the first paragraph are printed and transcribed as »; the first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The left-margin section mark is transcribed as §. Long s has been normalised to s throughout; no words are illegible. The catchword "tru-" stands alone at the lower right, below the last text line.
